# Humanity + AI, Inc.

> Humanity + AI, Inc. is a nonprofit organization dedicated to responsible AI adoption, human-centered technology leadership, and AI literacy for underserved communities.

## Key Public Pages

- [Home](https://humanityplusai.org/): Mission overview, featured programs, and community stats.
- [About](https://humanityplusai.org/about): Founder Danielle A. Franklin, organizational mission, values, and timeline.
- [Programs](https://humanityplusai.org/programs): Core initiatives including Project ROSIE, Tech Leadership, AI Ethics, Book Series, Community AI Literacy, AI Training Hub, and Animal Welfare.
- [Training / AI Learning Hub](https://humanityplusai.org/training): PJMF AI Journey framework, foundational AI layers, case studies, AI & Philanthropy resources, video courses, open-source tools, and learning paths.
- [Blog](https://humanityplusai.org/blog): Thought leadership articles and AI/ML resource books authored by board members and community contributors.
- [Events](https://humanityplusai.org/events): Upcoming workshops, seminars, and networking events.
- [AI Hub](https://humanityplusai.org/ai-hub): Community Q&A chatbot powered by OpenAI.
- [Contact](https://humanityplusai.org/contact): Contact form and organizational contact information.
- [Donate](https://humanityplusai.org/donate): Donation page supporting nonprofit programs and initiatives.
- [Board of Directors](https://humanityplusai.org/about): Profiles for board members including Danielle A. Franklin, Jofia, and William.

## Content Hubs

- Blog articles and books are accessible at `/blog/:slug`.
- Board member profiles are accessible at `/about/board/:slug`.
- Author profiles are accessible at `/profile/:username`.
- The full sitemap is available at [/sitemap.xml](https://humanityplusai.org/sitemap.xml).
